verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is physical GPU hardware. A downloadable OpenAPI-style web API spec is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no H200 API surface: NIM and build.nvidia.com inference endpoints are separate NVIDIA software services, not this product, and the OpenAPI probe on the developer portal returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
